candidates.title: Recover monthly active revenue index to ≥ 100
candidates.description: Restore monthly active revenue to baseline performance (index = 100) through a three-phase recovery programme addressing checkout issues, customer reactivation, and sustained growth. This is the headline measure for board reporting and represents full recovery from the incident.
candidates.target_value: Index ≥ 100 within 180 days from programme start
candidates.rationale: Explicitly stated as the headline measure and board-level target in both BASE docs.
candidates.evidence_citation: KPI Contract: 'Headline number for the board: monthly_active_revenue_index, baseline 100, target ≥ 100 by Day 180'

candidates.title: Restore weekly active sessions index to ≥ 95 (Phase 1 exit gate)
candidates.description: Fix checkout regression and restore weekly active sessions to near-baseline levels as the first phase deliverable. This is a lead indicator that must be achieved before progressing to revenue reactivation work.
candidates.rationale: Phase 1 exit gate criterion and lead indicator specified in both the Strategic Plan and KPI Contract.
candidates.evidence_citation: Strategic Plan Phase 1: 'Exit gate: weekly_active_sessions_index ≥ 95'; KPI Contract: 'weekly_active_sessions_index (target ≥ 95)'

candidates.title: Achieve checkout conversion rate ≥ pre-incident mean
candidates.description: Restore checkout conversion performance to pre-incident baseline levels by resolving technical regressions and user experience issues. This lead indicator directly supports session-to-revenue conversion recovery.
candidates.rationale: Identified as a lead indicator in the KPI Contract with explicit target to match historical mean.

candidates.title: Achieve 12% reactivation email response rate
candidates.description: Drive lapsed customer re-engagement through targeted reactivation campaigns, achieving a 12% response rate. This Phase 2 metric supports the recovery of monthly active revenue to ≥ 95% of baseline.
candidates.rationale: Explicitly defined as a lead indicator for Phase 2 customer reactivation efforts in the KPI Contract.

candidates.title: Complete Phase 2: restore revenue index to ≥ 95
candidates.description: Re-engage lapsed customers and restore monthly active revenue to 95% of baseline, completing the second phase of recovery. This intermediate milestone de-risks the path to full recovery (index ≥ 100).
candidates.rationale: Phase 2 exit gate defined in the Strategic Plan as a concrete intermediate milestone.
candidates.evidence_citation: Strategic Plan Phase 2: 'restore monthly active revenue to ≥ 95% of baseline. Exit gate: revenue index ≥ 95'
